{{Quote|He was a good fighter, one of my best men. A hero on Divac Seven. A true shame he's gone.|[[Ennix Devian]] – about [[Lonkin]]|<ref name="CEL">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Divac 7''' was a location in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the place where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Lonkin]] had distinguished himself in service, earning the title of hero.<ref name="CEL" />
